entries.title: Fixed Tapered Derrick and Open Rotary Floor Rig
entries.description: One newly authored complete reduced-proportion static derrick-rig exterior. An entire elevated thick rectangular rig floor has a real central through-opening, four full foot-and-leg supports and one continuous ground-to-deck approach stair. Four complete long converging corners and four whole tapered narrow-X-web triangular-aperture faces make a pyramidal tower around the central assembly. A complete open crown frame supports a true transverse axle and two full grooved sheaves. Inside the tower one entire lowered U block exposes two complete lower sheaves and carries a thick coupler with a single long blunt fixed rod passing freely through the actual annular rotary-table rim and through the floor. One whole double-flange rear drum, cross axle and full support bodies sit on the same deck; one entire finite-thickness static cable appearance links the drum, sheaves and crown. All visible coordinates newly authored with generic mesh helpers only, no old shaft-headframe, crane, winch or rod meshes imported. This is not the old two front-post/two raked-stay mine headframe with a single large top wheel over a ground collar, nor an equal-width tower crane with upper slewing head, opposite jibs and hook. One whole prop zero scenes, metres, native Z up, complete horizontal bounds centred over actual full soles, four opaque constant untextured PBR roles. Static artistic appearance only, no oilfield or manufacturer replica, underground well, sharp tool, fluids, pumps, pressure, fuel or process system. No drilling, extraction, spinning, cable travel, functional reeving, motion, tension, working load, access, manufacture, engineering or safety performance. Rigging, animation and interaction not made or verified.

entries.title: Fixed Four-Leg Straddle and Suspended Spreader Carrier
entries.description: One newly authored complete empty straddle-carrier vehicle exterior. Two independent long wheeled side chassis carry four full-height corner legs, two fixed upper side ties and two cross bridges, leaving the centre open from the ground. Two entire crosswise flanged drums and four fixed hanging-line exteriors support one complete shared-vertex rectangular spreader with a genuine large centre aperture and integral downward corner heads. A newly shaped high offset side cab with proud opaque windows, its separate platform and one whole connected ladder-like frame complete the vehicle; a compact upper rear cowl is fixed on the opposite side. Unlike the old Cartesian robot, there are no rail shoes, moving bridge, orthogonal tool slide or small fingers. Unlike the shop crane, there is no single rear mast with inclined actuator/boom and hook. This is not either old frame scaled up or given wheels: the complete side-chassis, four-point surrounding suspension and large low cargo interface are newly authored together. All coordinates are new; no old vehicle or gantry mesh imported. One prop zero scenes, no container or payload. Four opaque untextured PBR roles, metres Z up and horizontal-bounds-centred ground datum. Static artistic exterior only; no engine, steering, driving, rope mechanics, reeving, lifting, rated load, container fit, climbability, operator occupancy, manufacturing or road/port safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.

entries.title: Whole Swollen Trunk and High Fork Dry Tree
entries.description: One entirely newly authored stylised dry bottle-trunk tree. A low irregular flared foot grows into a massive asymmetric swollen barrel trunk, then contracts through rounded high shoulders into a short high branching crown. Thick crooked high limbs spread widely then turn upward, each with tapered returning terminal forks; there is no foliage canopy hiding the fork spaces. The trunk profile, crooked limb paths and complete silhouette are new, not a widened old umbrella trunk, changed leaf count or extracted root stump. Compared with the old narrow tapered umbrella trunk and its connected broad green crown, and the low riverbank fork with a long leaning leader and two green crown masses, this is a complete high-shouldered swollen-trunk dry-tree form. One model zero scenes. Coarse stylised environmental tree only, not exact baobab taxonomy, living growth, wood mechanics, ecology or safety. Rig animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Open Slot Case and Tripod Roll Screen
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed-expanded portable roll-screen exterior. Three whole splayed legs and separate finite shoes meet one central collar and a tall rear tubular mast, with three lower fixed stays. A narrow inner upper mast reaches a short forward hook supporting a whole top rail. A complete wide horizontal cylindrical case is rooted on the lower mast; its single thick C-section shell has a true continuous long upward slot and independent proud end caps. One uninterrupted thin opaque blank screen rises from inside that slot to the top rail. Its dark border and cream centre are face materials on one shared-vertex closed sheet, not duplicate coplanar overlays. No blackboard slab, panel-lift, easel, projector or old frame meshes reused. Unlike two-legged thick teaching boards this has a thin deployed sheet between lower slot case and upper rail on a rear tripod mast; unlike a wheeled lifting cradle it has no winch, wheels or tilting H carrier. Three finite ground shoes; four solid opaque PBR roles, metres Z up, complete bounds-centred horizontal origin; one prop zero scenes. Fixed appearance only: no retracting, winding, spring or tension mechanism, telescoping travel, projection optics, reflective performance, load, installation, stability or safety claim. No rigging, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Fixed Radial Slot Carousel and Front Lens Projector
entries.description: One newly authored complete carousel-slide-projector-style static exterior. A low chamfered horizontal case on two whole finite shoes carries a deep annular top cartridge with a continuous floor and inner and outer walls. Sixteen full radial partitions form genuinely empty upright slots around a separate central retaining pedestal. An independent forward annular lens barrel and collar contain a deeply recessed opaque optic; a blank side control and inset dark side ventilation exterior complete the silhouette. No old reels, ribbon, lamp chamber, chimney, cross-slide holder or camera meshes imported. All geometry new; four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, actual horizontal bounds centred, one whole prop zero scenes. Slot count is not the novelty: the whole radial cartridge over a low case and front lens replaces both high reel-and-ribbon organization and transverse-slide lantern organization. Fixed empty external representation only; no slide feed, rotation, optics, projection, illumination, ventilation, electricity, heat management, compatibility, manufacture or safety claim. No rigging, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Fixed Twin Loop Backframe and Long Nozzle Blower
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed backframe leaf-blower-style exterior, standing empty on its own broad lower skid. A tall integral backplate and two thick closed shoulder loops carry a low rounded reservoir exterior, a stepped transverse round fan-case exterior and one compact motor-shaped cap, with a complete raised carry arch. A continuous thick bent flexible-hose exterior leaves a lateral neck and sweeps forward into a separate long rigid nozzle with a genuine deep blind mouth and fixed control grip. It is not the old tall filter/bag collector put on a backpack: no collection vessel or filter tower remains, and the supporting backplate, two empty shoulder openings, lateral bend and long forward tube are authored as a whole compact pack. No old meshes imported. One complete model zero scenes, three opaque solid PBR roles. Static illustrative exterior only; no fan rotor, internal air circuit, fuel contents, airflow, blowing/cleaning, wearable fit, weight, vibration, emissions, operation or machinery safety ability. The terminal mouth is blind and does not imply a through hose. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Twin Side Brush and High Cab Road Sweeper
entries.description: One newly authored complete compact road-sweeper-style static vehicle exterior. Four whole flat-facet tyres and full hubs on two fixed cross axles carry a new low ladder frame, narrow tall forward cab with complete thick opaque window inserts and a full fixed sloping rear collection-body exterior. Two independently mounted outboard diagonal arms each carry one integral round brush deck/spindle and a continuous closed fluted brush appearance. Between them a whole low hood has a genuinely open forward/underside mouth, two full chassis mounts and a complete opaque rising side-duct exterior reaching the rear body. This entire pickup layout, forward high cab and fixed compact rear body are not the old single-disc two-wheel push-frame scrubber with a cab added, and not the offset-cab raised haul tub with brushes attached. No old vehicle, brush, tank or tool meshes imported; all visible coordinates newly authored. One whole static prop zero scenes, four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, native Z up and complete horizontal bounds centred over four real tyre facets. No people, dirt, road, liquids or process internals. Cabin and rear body are opaque exteriors, not occupiable or hollow chambers; the side duct does not claim a working internal air route. No driving, steering, wheel or brush rotation, suction, cleaning efficacy, hydraulics, electrics, disposal, noise, operator fit, manufacture, load or road/safety capability. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made or verified.

entries.title: Fixed Opposed Arms and Four Cord Suspension Platform
entries.description: One newly authored complete tabletop suspension-platform-style static display. A complete broad chamfered lower platform has a whole continuous rising inward-hook arm; a separate full upper platform has its own oppositely rooted descending inward-hook arm. Their free ends face each other at different heights with a real central gap and one complete short vertical cord joining them. Three separate full perimeter cords connect independent finite anchors at the two platforms, leaving all intermediate space open. The upper platform has no rigid continuous leg to the base: its explicitly drawn connections are the central and perimeter cords. Eight proud anchor heads complete the four illustrated connections. No old frame, sphere, chair rail or table parts imported, no spheres or payloads supplied. Newly authored whole profiles and coordinates; four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, whole XY bounds centred on the entire lower platform sole, one prop zero scenes. This is a fixed tension-table-style visual toy, not a claimed working physical prototype: no force or moment balance, tension, material stiffness, load bearing, stability, motion, instruction, manufacture or safety certification. No rigging, animation or interaction.
